compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: Hearing the word of truth and believing are followed by sealing with the promised Holy Spirit, described as a pledge of inheritance toward redemption.
observations.label: Hearers who believe are sealed with the promised Holy Spirit

observations.body: The passage presents Hearing, believing, and sealing as the scene's observable response or movement.

payload.posture: Read Ephesians 1:13–14 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states hearing the word of truth and believing are followed by sealing with the promised Holy Spirit, described as a pledge of inheritance toward redemption. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
payload.title: Hearers who believe are sealed with the promised Holy Spirit
